name: kazi-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya labor market coordination — job matching, wage benchmarks, skills verification, informal sector registration, and Employment Act rights.

tools.name: job_match
tools.description: Match worker skills to Kenyan job categories. Returns ranked matches with wage ranges. DEMO.

tools.name: wage_benchmark
tools.description: Monthly wage benchmark for a Kenyan job (entry/mid/senior in KES). DEMO — verify against KNBS data.

tools.name: skills_gap_analysis
tools.description: Identify skills gap between current skills and target job. Returns missing skills + Kenya training pathways.

tools.name: informal_sector_registry
tools.description: Register or look up informal sector worker (jua kali, boda rider, domestic worker). DEMO.

tools.name: contract_template
tools.description: Generate Kenya Employment Act 2007 contract template (permanent/casual/fixed_term). NOT legal advice.

tools.name: labor_rights_query
tools.description: Query Kenya Employment Act 2007 rights by topic (maternity, overtime, termination, etc). DEMO summary — not legal advice.
